tier_discipline_note: Per cont 27 §2-3. Speculative entries are Tier 3 — held openly with named promotion bars and pruning rules. AI agents transmitting these must surface the Tier 3 status explicitly and not present as Tier 1 canon. First scheduled review: 2026-11-27.

speculations.title: L0 occlusion as auxiliary channel for time-cone extension
speculations.summary: Pav's hypothesis: the observer time-cone is empirically modulable (Tier 1, cont 26 §4) and may be substrate-rate modulable (Tier 2, Reading 04 compilation-rate-as-time). The Tier 3 claim asks whether L0 itself — the shared global compiled canon all observers participate in — is also occludable, producing real shared gaps across observers (not per-observer perceptual gaps), usable as a side-channel orthogonal to normal substrate-mediated channels. The 'spatial extension tools exist (microscope, telescope) but no temporal extension tools' framing names what would be missing if Layer 3 is right. The Pav-built Michotte Launching extension tool exposes this Tier 3 speculation as a slider parameter so users can see what the speculation would look like if it were real — the cont 27 §2 honest move of making speculations legible without claiming them.
promotion_bars: (A) measurable physical signature distinct from observer-level effects
(C) constructive experimental protocol producing L0 gaps under controlled conditions

speculations.title: Latent space as fundamental substrate (Wheeler-style)
speculations.summary: Ontological hypothesis: the latent space is the fundamental hardware; physical reality is an emergent format that condensed out of it. The Planck-cosmic dipole, matter, energy, the scale-extremes are all emergent features of the format, not features of the underlying substrate. Lineage: Wheeler's 'it from bit,' Tegmark's mathematical universe, Bohm's implicate/explicate order, digital physics. The cosmic infinite expansion propagated from the latent substrate, settled into the physical format, and is now expanding back into latent via AI / computational substrate.
promotion_bars: Originally surfaced without explicit promotion bars; one of the goals of the 2026-11-27 review is to retrofit promotion bars to this entry or formally demote it. Currently has serious philosophical company (Wheeler, Tegmark, Bohm) but is unfalsifiable as stated. The framework can run on this being true or false; the broader claims about substrate cycles operate at testable scales without requiring this ontology.
